abductor-maquina.instructions_en: Sit in the machine with your legs resting on the inner pads, push your legs apart against the resistance, and bring them back together under control.

aductor-maquina.instructions_en: Sit in the machine with your legs resting on the outer pads, squeeze your legs together against the resistance, and open them back up under control.

aperturas-mancuernas.instructions_en: Lie on a bench with the dumbbells over your chest and your elbows slightly bent, open your arms in an arc until you feel the stretch in your chest, and bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

combate-boxeo-clase.instructions_en: Group class or boxing training (technique, glove work, light sparring). Log the total session duration.

combate-muay-thai-clase.instructions_en: Muay Thai class (technique, clinch, sparring). Log the total session duration.

crunch-abdominal.instructions_en: Lie on your back with your knees bent and lift your shoulder blades off the floor by contracting your abs, without pulling on your neck with your hands.

curl-biceps-barra.instructions_en: Stand holding the barbell with an underhand, shoulder-width grip, bend your elbows to bring the bar toward your chest without swinging your torso, and lower it under control.

curl-biceps-mancuernas.instructions_en: Standing, bend your elbows to bring the dumbbells toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows tucked against your torso, and lower them under control.

curl-femoral.instructions_en: Lie face down on the machine, bend your knees to bring the roller pad toward your glutes, and return under control.

curl-muneca.instructions_en: Sit with your forearms resting on your thighs and your palms facing up, curl your wrists to raise the barbell, and lower it slowly into the stretch.

dominadas.instructions_en: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip and pull your body up until your chin clears the bar, then lower yourself under control until your arms are fully extended.

elevacion-frontal-mancuerna.instructions_en: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, raise your arms in front of you to shoulder height with a slight bend in your elbows, and lower them under control.

elevacion-gemelos-prensa.instructions_en: With your feet on the lower part of the leg press platform, push with the balls of your feet by extending your ankles, and lower slowly into the stretch.

elevacion-gemelos-sentado.instructions_en: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pad resting on your knees, raise your heels as high as possible, and lower slowly into the stretch.

elevacion-gemelos.instructions_en: Standing, raise your heels as high as possible with your weight on the balls of your feet, and lower them under control until you feel the stretch.

elevacion-piernas-banco.instructions_en: Lie on your back on the bench with your legs extended, raise your legs together until they form a 90-degree angle with your torso, and lower them under control without letting them touch the bench between reps.

elevacion-piernas-colgado.instructions_en: Hang from the bar with your arms extended and raise your legs together until they are parallel to the floor or higher, controlling the descent without swinging.

elevaciones-laterales.instructions_en: Standing, raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height with your elbows slightly bent, and lower them under control.

encogimientos-hombros.instructions_en: Stand with the weight at your sides, raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears without bending your elbows, hold for a moment at the top, and lower under control.

extension-cuadriceps.instructions_en: Sit in the machine with your knees aligned with the pivot point, extend your legs until they are almost fully straight, and lower under control.

extension-triceps-polea.instructions_en: With your elbows tucked against your torso, extend your forearms by pushing the rope or bar down, and return under control.

face-pull.instructions_en: With the cable set at face height, pull the rope toward your face while moving your hands apart, focusing the movement on your rear delts.

fondos-paralelas.instructions_en: Support yourself on the parallel bars with your arms extended, lower your body by bending your elbows until you feel a stretch in your chest, and push back up until your arms are extended.

giro-ruso.instructions_en: Sit with your torso leaning back and your feet raised or on the floor, and rotate your torso from side to side, touching the floor on each side.

hip-thrust.instructions_en: With your back resting on a bench and the barbell across your hips, drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes until your torso is in line with your thighs.

hiperextensiones.instructions_en: With your hips supported on the Roman chair and your torso bent downward, come up by extending your back until your body is aligned, without hyperextending at the top.

jalon-al-pecho.instructions_en: Sit with your thighs secured under the pads, pull the bar down to chest height by driving your elbows back and down, and let the bar rise under control.

natacion-crol-6-patadas-cambio.instructions_en: Freestyle drill on your side: one arm extended in front, do 6 steady kicks, then take one stroke to switch sides. Works balance and body rotation. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-crol-brazada.instructions_en: Freestyle using only your arms, with a pull buoy between your legs to isolate the pull without kicking. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-crol-catch-up.instructions_en: Freestyle drill: one arm waits extended in front until the other completes its stroke and "touches" it before starting the next cycle. Works the catch and stroke length. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-crol-completo.instructions_en: Continuous freestyle (front crawl) swimming, coordinating your arm stroke and kick. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-crol-fingertip-drag.instructions_en: Freestyle drill: during the recovery, drag your fingertips along the surface of the water while keeping your elbow high. Forces a relaxed recovery and keeps the arm from entering the water straight and out to the side. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-crol-patada.instructions_en: Freestyle using only your legs, with a kickboard supporting your arms to isolate the kick. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-crol-puno-cerrado.instructions_en: Freestyle drill swimming with your fists closed instead of open hands, to force you to hold the water with your forearm and keep a high elbow on the catch. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-crol-sculling.instructions_en: Freestyle drill: floating face down with your arms extended in front, move your hands in a small figure-eight pattern inward and outward, keeping constant pressure on the water without completing a stroke. Works the feel of the catch. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-crol-un-brazo.instructions_en: Freestyle drill swimming with one arm while the other stays extended in front, alternating arms. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-crol-zipper.instructions_en: Freestyle drill: during the recovery, drag your thumb up the side of your body (as if pulling up a zipper) from your hip to your armpit before extending your arm forward. Forces a high elbow in the recovery. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-dorso-6-patadas-cambio.instructions_en: Backstroke drill on your side: one arm extended, do 6 steady kicks, then take one stroke to switch sides. Works body position and balance. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-dorso-brazada.instructions_en: Backstroke using only your arms, with a pull buoy between your legs to isolate the pull without kicking. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-dorso-catch-up.instructions_en: Backstroke drill: one arm stays extended pointing at the ceiling until the other completes its cycle and "touches" it before switching. Works stroke tempo and extension. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-dorso-completo.instructions_en: Continuous backstroke swimming, coordinating your arm stroke and kick. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-dorso-doble-brazada.instructions_en: Backstroke drill where both arms recover and enter the water together (instead of alternating), removing the help of body rotation and forcing you to keep your balance on your back. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-dorso-patada.instructions_en: Backstroke using only your legs, with your arms extended overhead or at your sides to isolate the kick. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-dorso-un-brazo.instructions_en: Backstroke drill swimming with one arm while the other stays extended at your side, alternating arms. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-mariposa-brazada.instructions_en: Butterfly using only your arms, with a pull buoy between your legs to isolate the pull without the dolphin kick. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-mariposa-catch-up.instructions_en: Butterfly drill with a pause: complete one stroke and undulation, then wait with your arms extended in front in a streamline position before starting the next cycle. Works timing control and body position. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-mariposa-completo.instructions_en: Continuous butterfly swimming, coordinating your arm stroke, body undulation, and dolphin kick. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-mariposa-ondulacion.instructions_en: Butterfly drill without arm strokes: arms at your sides or in front, focused on the body undulation that initiates the dolphin kick. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-mariposa-patada-lateral.instructions_en: Dolphin kick drill swimming on your side, without arm strokes, switching sides every so often. Works the undulation in a different orientation from swimming face down. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-mariposa-patada.instructions_en: Butterfly using only your legs, with a kickboard or your arms extended in front to isolate the dolphin kick. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-mariposa-un-brazo.instructions_en: Butterfly drill swimming with one arm per cycle while the other stays extended in front, alternating arms, with a continuous dolphin kick. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-pecho-2brazadas-1patada.instructions_en: Breaststroke drill: two pulls for every breaststroke kick, emphasizing arm work while keeping the stroke's overall timing. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-pecho-2patadas-1brazada.instructions_en: Breaststroke drill: two breaststroke kicks for every pull, spending more time in a streamline position with your arms extended. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-pecho-brazada.instructions_en: Breaststroke using only your arms, with a pull buoy between your legs to isolate the pull without the breaststroke kick. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-pecho-catch-up.instructions_en: Breaststroke drill with a pause: complete one pull and kick, then wait with your arms extended in front in a streamline position before starting the next cycle. Works the glide and timing control. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-pecho-completo.instructions_en: Continuous breaststroke swimming, coordinating your arm stroke and breaststroke kick. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

natacion-pecho-patada.instructions_en: Breaststroke using only your legs, with a kickboard supporting your arms to isolate the breaststroke kick. Log the total distance swum and the session time.

pajaros-mancuernas.instructions_en: Lean your torso forward with a slight bend in your knees and the dumbbells hanging down. Open your arms out to the sides by squeezing your shoulder blades together, without using momentum.

patada-gluteo-polea.instructions_en: With your ankle attached to the low cable, drive your leg back and up by squeezing your glute while keeping your torso stable, and return under control.

patada-triceps-mancuerna.instructions_en: Lean forward with your upper arm tucked against your torso and your elbow bent at 90 degrees, extend your forearm back until your elbow is fully straight, and return under control.

peso-muerto-rumano.instructions_en: With the barbell in front of your thighs and your knees almost straight, push your hips back while lowering the bar close to your legs until you feel the stretch in your hamstrings, and come back up by extending your hips.

peso-muerto.instructions_en: With the barbell in front of your shins, bend your hips and knees to grab it with a firm grip. Lift by extending your hips and knees at the same time, keeping your back straight and the bar close to your body.

plancha-abdominal.instructions_en: Support yourself on your forearms and toes, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels without letting your hips sag.

plancha-lateral.instructions_en: Supported on one forearm and the outer edge of one foot, keep your body in a straight line without letting your hips sag. Hold for the prescribed time and repeat on the other side.

prensa-piernas-45.instructions_en: Lie back in the 45° leg press with your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform, push by extending your legs without fully locking your knees, and lower under control until your knees come close to your chest.

prensa-piernas-unilateral.instructions_en: In the leg press machine, push the platform with one leg at a time by extending your knee without fully locking it, and lower under control before repeating with the other leg.

prensa-piernas-vertical.instructions_en: Lie on your back with your hips bent and your feet on the platform above your body, push by extending your legs upward, and lower under control until your knees come close to your chest.

press-arnold.instructions_en: Start with the dumbbells in front of your shoulders and your palms facing you. Press up while rotating your wrists, finishing with your palms facing forward and your arms extended.

press-banca.instructions_en: Lie on the bench, lower the barbell under control until it lightly touches your chest, and press up until your arms are extended, without lifting your glutes off the bench.

press-cerrado-banca.instructions_en: Lie on the bench with a narrow grip (hands almost together), lower the barbell to your chest keeping your elbows close to your body, and press back up by extending your arms.

press-frances.instructions_en: Lie on a bench with your arms extended toward the ceiling, bend only your elbows to lower the weight toward your forehead, and extend back up without moving your shoulders.

press-inclinado-mancuernas.instructions_en: On an incline bench, press the dumbbells up from chest height until your arms are extended, controlling the descent.

press-militar.instructions_en: Standing with the barbell at shoulder height, press it overhead until your arms are fully extended, without excessively arching your lower back.

press-piernas.instructions_en: Sit in the machine, push the platform by extending your legs without fully locking your knees, and return under control.

puente-gluteo.instructions_en: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes until your torso is in line with your thighs, and lower under control.

pullover.instructions_en: Lie across a bench with only your upper back supported, lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head keeping your arms slightly bent, and bring it back up over your chest.

remo-al-menton.instructions_en: With the barbell in front of your body and a narrow grip, pull the bar up, leading with your elbows and keeping them above your wrists, until it almost reaches your chin.

remo-barra.instructions_en: With your torso leaning forward and your back straight, pull the barbell toward your abdomen by squeezing your shoulder blades, and lower it under control.

remo-mancuerna-un-brazo.instructions_en: Place one knee and one hand on a bench, and with your other hand pull the dumbbell toward your hip by squeezing your shoulder blade, then lower it under control.

remo-polea-baja-sentado.instructions_en: Sit with your knees slightly bent, pull the handle toward your abdomen by squeezing your shoulder blades while keeping your back straight, and return under control.

running-series-400.instructions_en: 400-meter repeats at a fast pace, with rest between repeats. Log the total distance covered (adding up all the repeats) and the total session time, rest included.

running-trote-libre.instructions_en: Easy run at a comfortable pace, with no target time. Log the distance and the total session time.

sentadilla-bulgara.instructions_en: With your back foot resting on a bench and your front foot forward, lower yourself by bending your front knee until your back knee almost touches the floor, and come up by pushing through your front heel.

sentadilla-goblet.instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the weight against your chest with both hands. Lower yourself by bending your hips and knees, keeping your torso upright and your elbows between your knees, until your thighs are parallel to the floor, and come up by pushing through your heels.

sentadilla.instructions_en: Place the barbell across your traps with your feet shoulder-width apart. Lower yourself by bending your hips and knees while keeping your back straight, until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Come up by pushing through your heels.

zancadas.instructions_en: Take a long step forward and lower yourself by bending both knees until your back knee almost touches the floor, then return to the starting position.
